builds.name: Fey Feathers: AP self-shield
builds.summary: Investigate high one fresh Fey Feathers shield output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one fresh Fey Feathers shield output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The passive shield scales from 30 to 225 by champion level plus 0.95 AP. AP and eligible shield power can make this self-shield large. Attacks and abilities against champions reduce its cooldown, but neither creates free simultaneous shield layers nor scales the shield by the number of cooldown-reduction hits.
